ModMetaData.name: Salvation Rites
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The liturgy tree: five rites the clan does not buy but is given, as the ship remembers. Scrap Shrine, Conduit Choir, God-Speaker Array, Liturgy of the Hull, and the day The Gods Speak Back.
Authored 2026-09-04 on the owner's ruling (RESEARCH_TREE_NORMALIZATION_1 rulings block). v1 ships the tab and the five ResearchProjectDefs, chained T0..T4. The revealed-not-bought gate is LIVE (RITES_REVEAL_MECHANISM_1, 2026-09-04): each tier past the Scrap Shrine carries a hiddenPrerequisites on an Antiquities stage — Choir needs LANGUAGE, God-Speaker RELIGION, Hull CULTURE, Gods Speak Back VOICE (design/Jawa/antiquities_design.md section 2; ANTIQUITIES_TREE_BUILD_1). Owner ruling: visible-locked, not truly hidden — the row still renders greyed until its stage finishes (verified against MainTabWindow_Research.cs: vanilla hiddenPrerequisites gates CanStartNow only, never the tree's own visibility filter). Subspace gravitic penetration's flavor folds into the God-Speaker Array per design/Jawa/research_review/functionless_tech_candidates.md.
Also the religion's own places: Ishko the Unmaskable's three landmarks, the Lightless Sink, the Shadowed Overhang and the Cold Lava Tube (Odyssey LandmarkDefs on plain Hollow, Chasm and Cavern ground, icons from mandrake.rut.ashkarrlandmarkart). Their names are principles of his doctrine, not promises about the terrain. They moved here 2026-10-22 from the retired mandrake.rut.ishkolandmarks (owner: "It's a concept, not a mod."; "I think the Nine Gods belong in Salvation Rites."). Placing them on the Ash'karr world is the owner's hand.
